subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Transfer Functions: Input to Output
description: Learn Transfer Functions: Input to Output in one minute.

hook.text: A transfer function is a mathematical recipe: what output do you get for a given input?

buildup.text: In the Laplace domain, a transfer function is a ratio of polynomials: G(s) = Y(s)/X(s).

discovery.text: The denominator's roots are poles — they determine whether the system is stable or not.

twist.text: Zeros in the numerator shape the response — they can speed things up or create unexpected dips.

climax.text: Engineers design controllers by reshaping the closed-loop transfer function's poles and zeros.

punchline.text: Poles for stability, zeros for shape — the transfer function tells all.

quiz.question: What do the poles of a transfer function determine?
options: The gain of the system at DC
Whether the system is stable and how it responds dynamically
The physical dimensions of the system
